outfit.name: 束腰羊毛排扣大衣与格纹暖融冬装
outfit.prose: A tailored dark navy wool military-inspired double-breasted coat tightly cinched at the waist with an oversized buckle belt, draped with a blue-grey tartan cashmere scarf. Below the flared coat hem peek sheer black tights accented by an inner-thigh leather holster strap, paired with polished knee-high riding boots.
